correctness.rationale: The exact source ODE and positivity domain were checked against 2026 primary equations (6)-(10). Differentiate the cost log odds: its derivative contains the factor alpha-beta. With k=(alpha-beta)(theta1+theta2)/(mu1+mu2) the cooperation terms cancel, yielding Lprime=h(r-rstar). Compact forward invariance would bound L, contradicted by uniform sign when rstar is outside [0,1]; integrating the two logit derivatives yields the time averages. Both exponential inequalities follow immediately and sharpness witnesses are exact-rational equilibria for every rational target risk, extended algebraically to every real target risk. The independent standard-library checker passed 219 rational identity/equilibrium cases and two feedback witnesses; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A full three-dimensional evolutionary-feedback model can exhibit complex transient behavior, and a census of equilibria cannot exclude closed or chaotic recurrent sets. The exact odds clock provides the stronger global nonpersistence theorem for every payoff scale, group size and quota; its strict-imbalance bounds quantify the environmental tradeoff, while the mean-risk and mean-cooperation laws supply concrete diagnostics for any proposed persistent orbit. The attainable interior-equilibrium family at every rstar in (0,1) demonstrates a sharp obstruction in the feedback-target parameter, not just an arbitrary negative or parameter-substitution exercise.
